candidate.definition_en: To suffer something painful or difficult patiently; to remain in existence.
candidate.explanation_ar: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة زي الألم أو المعاناة. وكمان بتيجي بمعنى يستمر ويبقى.

senses.definition_en: To suffer something painful, difficult, or unpleasant patiently.
senses.definition_ar: يتحمل أو يطيق أمراً مؤلماً أو شاقاً بصبر.
examples: She had to endure a long flight.
Humanity has the capacity to endure even the most catastrophic events.

senses.definition_en: To continue to exist or last over a long period.
senses.definition_ar: يستمر أو يصمد ويبقى على مر الزمن.
examples: His fame will endure for centuries.
She had to endure a long flight.
Humanity has the capacity to endure even the most catastrophic events.
His fame will endure for centuries.
candidate.mnemonic: لازم تتحمل للآخر 'End' لحد ما نلاقي 'Cure' 'علاج'.. 'Endure'
